title: Linda Medley
description: Getting wrapped up in his work: the musical Mr. McCool enveloped by beautiful Oola, Jabba the Hutt's dancing slave girl. "Take five, Droopy!" says Linda Medley, who's been drawing comics since 1987. Medley's work has appeared in DC's ACTION COMICS, JUSTICE LEAGUE, WONDER WOMAN and WHO'S WHO, as well as THE GALACTIC GIRL GUARDS (Tundra). She is currently THE DOOM PATROL for Vertigo.
